visual_identity.full_fusion_brief_en:
Use case: image-edit, strict helmet redesign with BODY LOCK.
Create one revised full-body concept image, portrait 1024 x 1536 pixels. Reference 1 is the CURRENT designed armored human and is authoritative for every part BELOW THE HEAD: preserve exactly the existing body armor, chest, shoulders, orange neck insert, forearms, hands, hips, thighs, knees, boots, color placement, body proportions, stance, camera angle, material style and neutral gray background. Change only the HELMET and its short soft neck connection.
References 2, 3 and 4 show the actual ORIGINAL Star Warfare KNIGHT armor from front/side/oblique-back. THESE ORIGINAL HELMET VIEWS HAVE THE HIGHEST PRIORITY for the head silhouette. The user likes the original Knight helmet and explicitly requests an improved version BASED ON IT. Do not substitute a Halo/PREFECT helmet or another generic futuristic helmet. Do not alter the body to match the old low-poly suit.
KNIGHT HEAD IDENTITY TO RESTORE: a broad externally flared octagonal HAT-LIKE BRIM wrapping continuously around the helmet, especially projecting widely over both ears and far back at the nape; in side profile this is a clear nearly horizontal rim, distinct from the raised crown. Deep gray-blue-black crown rising to a central forward-pointing ridge, with exactly TWO short pointed triangular horn tabs, one on each upper side. Keep the original three large crown fields and small acid-green inset bars; simplify current concept's excessive segmented crown seams. Beneath the brim, a broad smooth luminous lime-green continuous faceplate descends across the eyes AND lower central face almost to the jaw, surrounded by a simple dark gray-blue cheek cradle with pointed lower chin outline. Preserve the original dark horizontal brow block hanging slightly down over the top of the green glass, and the broad green lower-face silhouette. The head must unmistakably read as the original Knight's wide-brimmed pointed-crown design, improved in surface quality rather than replaced.
IMPROVE ONLY practical craft: credible thickened brim edges and beveled crown plates; soft black liner visible under neck and behind glass edges; compact human-sized ear connectors; two short cleaner cheek guards; crisp sealing gasket; restrained subtle wear. Keep acid lime continuous visor rather than two robot eyes, and the gray-blue-black original color. Brim needs enough width to remain visibly distinct from the current concept helmet even at full-body image size, but still human-wearable, no enormous sombrero. TWO horns stay short, no new third spike. Current body must remain unchanged, no backpack, weapons, extra character, badges, insignia, Halo logo or text. Full figure from helmet tips to complete soles, no cropping. Same painted matte sci-fi HUMAN armor style as reference 1.

actual_reviews.concept: 已依使用者新方向目視：原 Knight 外翻寬八角帽沿在左右與後頸更清楚，中央尖冠／兩枚短角、大塊亮綠連續面罩與原灰藍黑配色保留；厚度、內襯、護頰改良。既有身體護甲、橘頸襯、姿勢及配色保持一致，未再以 PREFECT 頭盔主導。
actual_reviews.construction: 使用者新方向已目視：原 Knight 外翻八角寬帽沿、中央尖冠／兩短角、大片亮綠面窗在拆解及穿戴示意中一致保留；護頰、软內襯、短軟頸清楚，未改成 PREFECT 盔。肩甲及 B-17 灰綠青窗背包維持原新設計，三組拆解與頸腋間隙可讀。
actual_reviews.turnaround: 使用者新方向已目視：三視統一原 Knight 寬外翻八角帽沿、中央尖冠與兩短角、大塊亮綠面罩；側面及背面完整帽沿突出可讀。既有身體與 B-17 灰綠青窗背包保持，三個全身與腳底基線完整。

proposed_abilities.name: 等拍穩定
proposed_abilities.trigger: 完整四件、存活，使用半自動武器在該武器合法射擊間隔的1.0至1.3倍內連續命中射擊時機
proposed_abilities.effect: 累積3次後降低後座10%，持續到節拍中斷；只調後座、不改命中機率、彈藥或傷害
proposed_abilities.limits: 失誤、換彈、換武器、受硬直或1.5秒未射擊清空；全自動武器不適用；節拍容差需實測無障礙設定
proposed_abilities.stop: 死亡、卸下任何一件或離開關卡即停止；未結算承傷須按能力規格結清，不以卸裝取消代價。
proposed_abilities.integration_note: 新玩法，尚未接入runtime、多人同步或平衡；需先驗證觸發、取消、重複事件與邊界。
proposed_abilities.equipment_dependency: 完整C裝甲四件；B背包可獨立混搭，不繼承此能力。
proposed_abilities.visual: 技能顯示與收納裝置需後續另行設計，現有概念圖不代表機制已完成。

modeling_authority: 本輪概念圖及逐張目視紀錄定義採用外觀；三視與拆解為建模參考。少量透視、遮擋或跨視細節須在模型統一，不可當精確尺寸、UV或已完工資產。
